_comment: wintty.c docorner() clears each row a partial menu covered and reprints the map from gbuf, including map row ROWNO-1, which lies on the first of three status rows on a 24-row terminal. ^F maps the level, so the corridor on row 20 is remembered; the #name getobj menu covers the status rows; select_menu() keeps bot() disabled through the repair, so the getlin prompt shows that corridor over the cleared status suffix.
